2608.19957.title: Natural Language Code Retrieval for 1C:Enterprise: An Open Benchmark and Efficient Bi-Encoder
2608.19957.paper_summary: Natural language code retrieval is a rapidly evolving task in computer science. However, the 1C:Enterprise ecosystem combines Russian syntax with highly domain-specific terminology, for which open datasets and specialized models have been virtually non-existent. We present a comprehensive pipeline for 1C code retrieval: an open benchmark of 3,413 real-world, PII-scrubbed query-code pairs, a reproducible evaluation harness, and a specialized bi-encoder. To overcome scarce labeled data, we fine-tune on 784,057 synthetic triplets generated by google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it from public code repositories, using Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) and a privacy-aware tokenizer. Because the benchmark subsets differ in size, we report balanced-subset macro, query-weighted micro, and forum-only results. Our model reaches 0.5992 balanced macro nDCG@10, 0.5044 micro, and 0.4617 on forum, versus 0.4932 macro for the baseline architecture and 0.5404 for google/embeddinggemma-300m. Removing every benchmark example flagged by the conservative exact/13-gram overlap audit leaves 0.6011 balanced macro (0.5010 micro), indicating that detected train-benchmark overlap does not explain the headline result. MRL truncation to 256 dimensions preserves 99.9% of retrieval quality while reducing dense-index storage and exact similarity arithmetic by a factor of three.
2608.19957.paper_summary_zh: 自然語言代碼檢索是計算機科學中一個快速發展的任務。<lb/>然而，1C:Enterprise 生態系統結合了俄語語法和高度特定於領域的術語，對於這些術語，開放數據集和專門模型幾乎不存在。<lb/>我們提出了一個全面的 1C 代碼檢索管道：一個包含 3,413 個真實世界的、經過個人識別信息（PII）刪除的查詢-代碼對的開放基準、一個可重複的評估工具，以及一個專門的雙編碼器。<lb/>為了克服標記數據稀缺的問題，我們在 784,057 個由 google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 從公共代碼庫生成的合成三元組上進行微調，使用 Matryoshka 表示學習（MRL）和一個隱私意識的分詞器。<lb/>由於基準子集的大小不同，我們報告了平衡子集宏觀、查詢加權微觀和僅論壇的結果。<lb/>我們的模型達到了 0.5992 的平衡宏觀 nDCG@10、0.5044 的微觀和 0.4617 的論壇結果，相較於基線架構的 0.4932 宏觀和 google/embeddinggemma-300m 的 0.5404。<lb/>刪除每個被保守的精確/13-gram 重疊審核標記的基準示例後，留下 0.6011 的平衡宏觀（0.5010 微觀），這表明檢測到的訓練-基準重疊並不能解釋標題結果。<lb/>將 MRL 截斷到 256 維度保留了 99.9% 的檢索質量，同時將密集索引存儲和精確相似度運算減少了三倍。
